integrity: The full theorem is proved in RESULT.md, and the complete 255-node finite online witness is included with a standalone checker. Finite tests do not substitute for the all-order proofs.
scientific_limitations: The exact Littlestone dimension at every length is not claimed. The all-order theorem uses elementary 231-avoidance, while the online gap depends on an explicit finite tree independently checked by its companion code and a proved direct-sum amplification. Historical priority under other terminology remains a risk; no independent audit has been performed.
title: Comparison shattering of stack-sortable permutations and a linear online gap
